correctness.rationale: The true-variance Gaussian plus centered compound-Poisson MGF factors as V t²/2 times [1+delta(F(bt)-1)], where F is the MGF of Beta(1,2) times the square-biased bounded jump. Its exact optimal pole is c/b=sup_{s>0} delta(F-1)/[s(1+delta(F-1))]. The endpoint power law yields F~K e^s/s^(beta+2) and F'/F=1-(beta+2)/s+o(1/s); a comparison point and exp/s bounds force all maximizing s/L->1. Stationarity gives delta(F-1)=s-(beta+3)+o(1), hence optimizer s=L+(beta+3)log L-log K+o(1) and b/c=s+1+o(1). For Beta(1,1), Beta(1,2) jumps our independent high-precision stationarity calculations at L=40,90,200 corroborated the decreasing remainders. Does not prove maximizer uniqueness or cover beta=0.
